name: National Flag API Sync for WooCommerce
author: nationalflag

sections.description:
Connects a WooCommerce store to the National Flag product API. Products, prices and images are imported automatically and kept up to date.

A National Flag reseller account with API access is required.

Features

  • Full National Flag product range imported, with colours and sizes as variations.
  • Colour swatches and a quantity box per size on the product page.
  • Reseller markup on products and branding, with optional rounding.
  • Quantity price breaks and minimum order quantities.
  • Branding options per product, with print and setup charges.
  • Products grouped into National Flag categories and subcategories.
  • Scheduled sync for new products, price changes and discontinued items.
  • Change report after every sync, with CSV export.
  • Health check for the login, the connection and hosting settings.
  • Reseller titles, descriptions and categories kept on update.

External Services

Product data, prices, images and documents come from services run by National Flag (Pty) Ltd. National Flag’s Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy apply.

National Flag API

apinationalflag.kickatinalong.net is used to log in and download the product range during a sync, a login test or a health check. Only the API email, password and access token are sent. No store, customer or order data is sent.

National Flag Image Storage

Product images and documents load from katacloudstorage.blob.core.windows.net on Microsoft Azure. Shopper browsers request these files directly, so the service receives shopper IP addresses. Each new image is also read once by the store to record the image size. Microsoft’s Privacy Statement applies.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin. WooCommerce must be active.
  2. Go to WooCommerce > National Flag Sync.
  3. Enter the National Flag API email and password, then click Test login.
  4. Set the markup and click Save settings.
  5. Click Sync now. The first import runs in the background.
sections.faq:
Is a National Flag Account Needed?

Yes. API login details are issued by National Flag.

Where Do the Product Images Come From?

Images load directly from National Flag’s image storage and are not copied to the media library.

What Happens to Discontinued Products?

Discontinued products are set to draft on the next sync, or to private or the bin if chosen in the settings. Products that return to the product range are restored automatically.

Can Categories Be Excluded?

Yes. Categories and subcategories can be switched off on the Categories tab.

Does the Plugin Send Orders to National Flag?

No. Orders stay in the store. Each order line shows the National Flag product code on the admin order screen.
